prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Draw FOUR full-body sprite animation keys of the EXACT soft ivory paper-cloak hero from the two reference images. Input1 falling pose identity/style reference; input2 approved idle proportions and clothing. Equal 2x2 cells on genuinely transparent RGBA background, no backdrop gradients, glows, shadows, text, labels, lines or ground. Strict RIGHT SIDE PROFILE in every cell. Large same-size round ivory head with single black oval eye near right edge; short compact legs, plain shorts, long layered paper cloak a little darker than body, fine matte paper texture, thin warm dark outlines. Soft rounded shapes. Both arms and hands completely hidden within cloak. Keep all characters fully inside their cell with wide transparent margins, identical head scale. No joint rig, noodle limbs, elongated legs, hats, new details, eyes or visible fingers.
This is FALLING DOWN WITHOUT JUMPING: stepping off a ledge, gravity drops the character. NO jump crouch, upward push, jumping tuck or takeoff pose.
Top left: STEP OFF EDGE. Torso nearly upright with mild forward lean, near short leg slightly ahead and losing support, far foot trailing slightly back; legs start hanging down. Cape retains some idle drape, tips only begin lifting. No platform drawn.
Top right: EARLY FALL. Short legs drop underneath hips, knees softly unlocked, feet point down slightly. Head looks right. Cape outer broad layers lift upward/backward in the air; central wrap still covers arms/body.
Bottom left: SUSTAINED FALL. Torso upright, BOTH short legs hanging under hips with a small natural knee bend, near leg brighter and far leg muted taupe. Feet remain under body, not spread. Long paper cape fans UPWARD and BACK behind shoulders in broad soft folds, like air resistance, visibly stronger upward flutter than early fall. Never tuck knees toward chest; this is descending.
Bottom right: LANDING ABSORPTION. Both small soles planted on a shared baseline, knees bent to absorb downward motion, torso compresses by bending at knees and hips (do not shrink head). Cloak is still floating upward/backward behind shoulders and begins settling. Compact natural landing, not an attack. Preserve same head, palette and paper texture.
Whole-frame drawings only. Actual vertical world movement will be applied separately by game; do not offset the four characters to depict a trajectory.

processing: Crop and uniformly register full drawings. Reuse existing recovery PNG unchanged. No joints or body morphing. Gravity and landing determine runtime duration.
